label: Netgear Nighthawk M1 LTE Cat 16 hotspot (MR1100)
description: LTE Cat 16 mobile router (MR1100) at 1 Gbps down / 150 Mbps up with 4-band carrier aggregation and 4x4 MIMO. One Gigabit Ethernet port plus dual-band 802.11ac Wi-Fi at 867 + 300 Mbps; the LTE uplink is carried as the Ethernet-class interface wan5g.
